subject: One Toggle Now Turns Your Site Invisible to Every AI Answer on Earth
headline: Google rolled its new Search Console "Search generative AI performance" report out to every website worldwide on Aug 31 (impressions by page/country/device/date across AI Overviews, AI Mode, and Discover, but no click or query data), alongside a single opt-out toggle covering all three AI surfaces at once. The same day, Optimizely launched Virtual Teammates in its Opal platform: five role-specific AI personas (Chief of Staff, SEO & AI Search Analyst, Marketing Analyst, Personalization Strategist, CRO Manager) that retain org context and run on a schedule instead of one-off prompting, aimed at the 81% of B2B marketing leaders juggling disconnected AI tools weekly. Action steps cover checking the new AI performance report, making a deliberate opt-out call, applying GEO tactics (citing sources, adding statistics and quotes) shown to boost AI-search visibility up to 30-40%, and auditing which daily AI tool tasks could become a persistent Virtual Teammate role.
